newsitem.title: ITALY: Average Italian CPI Jan-Oct 4.1 percent - Istat.
newsitem.headline: Average Italian CPI Jan-Oct 4.1 percent - Istat.

text.p: Average Italian inflation in the first 10 months of the year was 4.1 percent compared with 5.3 percent in the same period last year, the national statistics office Istat said.
The government has set an average inflation target of 3.9 percent for the whole year.
The head of studies in Istat's inflation office, Guido Vaccaro, indicated that he expected the consumer price index to fall further next month.
Inflation rose a high 0.6 percent month-on-month in November 1995 to give a year-on-year figure of 6.0 percent.
"If this November the month-on-month increase is less than 0.6 percent then the year-on-year figure will be less than 3.0 percent," Vaccaro said.

"In recent months we haven't had a month-on-month increase of 0.6 percent and so far we haven't had any increases in tariffs which would weigh on the month-on-month figure," he added. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
